zh.title: Oil Find 搜索语法：通配符、正则、拼音和筛选条件
zh.description: Oil Find 支持的全部搜索写法：同时包含、或、排除、通配符、正则，按扩展名、类型、大小、修改时间和路径筛选，以及键盘快捷键。
zh.intro: 在搜索框里直接输入。多个条件用空格隔开，表示同时满足。在应用里按 ⌘/ 可以随时打开这张表。

en.title: Oil Find search syntax: wildcards, regex and filters
en.description: Every way to search in Oil Find: AND, OR, NOT, wildcards, regular expressions, filters by extension, kind, size, date and path, plus keyboard shortcuts.
en.intro: Type these straight into the search field. Separate conditions with spaces to require all of them. In the app, press ⌘/ to open this reference at any time.

zh.title: Mac 上有 Everything 吗？用 Oil Find 一样按文件名秒搜
zh.description: Everything 只有 Windows 版。Oil Find 为 Mac 提供免费开源的文件名搜索，也能搜索本地 Claude Code、Codex 和 WorkBuddy 对话。
zh.intro: Everything 是 Windows 上很多人离不开的文件搜索工具，但它没有 Mac 版。Oil Find 用同样的思路为 Mac 重新写了一个：给磁盘上所有文件名建一份内存索引，按 ⇧⌘F，输入即出结果。

faq.a: 没有。Everything 由 voidtools 开发，只支持 Windows。

faq.q: Oil Find 和 Everything 有关系吗？
faq.a: 没有关系。Oil Find 是独立开发的 Mac 应用，只是思路相同。
免费开源，包含文件名搜索以及本地 Claude Code、Codex 和 WorkBuddy 对话搜索。图片与文档全文检索等功能由付费 Pro 版提供。
目前只支持 Apple 芯片的 Mac，macOS 14 及以上。

sections.title: 一样的地方
items: 文件搜索只按名称查找，不读取文件正文：85 万个文件，单次按键响应不到 10 毫秒。
文件新建、改名、删除，索引实时更新。
支持通配符、正则，按类型、大小、修改时间筛选。

sections.title: 为 Mac 做的地方
items: 原生应用：面板在屏幕正中，全键盘操作，按空格用 Quick Look 预览，结果可以拖到其他应用。
拼音首字母和全拼：输入 wd 就能找到「文档」。
默认不索引开发依赖、应用包内部和系统目录，结果更干净；需要时在设置里打开。
同一个搜索面板还能检索保存在本机的 Claude Code、Codex 和 WorkBuddy 对话标题与正文，免费版即可使用。

en.title: Everything for Mac: Oil Find, instant file search by name
en.description: Everything is Windows-only. Oil Find is a free, open-source Mac app for file names and local Claude Code, Codex, and WorkBuddy conversations.
en.intro: Everything is the file search tool many Windows users can’t live without, and it has no Mac version. Oil Find rebuilds the idea for macOS: an in-memory index of every file name on your disk. Press ⇧⌘F and results appear as you type.

faq.q: Is there a Mac version of Everything?
faq.a: No. Everything is developed by voidtools and runs only on Windows.

faq.q: Is Oil Find related to Everything?
faq.a: No. Oil Find is an independent Mac app built on the same idea.
Free and open source, including file name search and local conversations from Claude Code, Codex, and WorkBuddy. Search inside images and documents is part of the paid Pro version.
Not yet. Oil Find needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later.

sections.title: What’s the same
items: File search looks up names without reading contents: 850,000 files in under 10 ms per keystroke.
The index follows along as files are created, renamed and deleted.
Wildcards, regular expressions, and filters by kind, size and date.
External drives are searchable as soon as you plug them in.

sections.title: What’s made for the Mac
items: A native app: a panel in the middle of the screen, full keyboard control, Quick Look with Space, and drag and drop into other apps.
Pinyin initials and full pinyin for Chinese file names.
Dependency folders, app internals and system folders are left out by default for cleaner results. Turn them on in Settings when you need them.
The same search panel also searches titles and body text from local Claude Code, Codex, and WorkBuddy conversations, included in the free version.
Open source under the MIT license.
